beats.line: extending a massive two thousand two hundred nine meters down
for reference you could fit around twenty-four Statues of Liberty inside of it
or for my European audience, seven Eiffel Towers
and for the rest of the world, thirty-one thousand six hundred eighty Big Macs
Now there has only been one recorded death inside of the cave
but do not let that number fool you. This is easily one
of the most dangerous high-difficulty maps on the planet
As you begin your journey you will be presented with your first major challenge
simply finding it. The entrance to this massive
abyss is a tiny three-by-four-meter opening
